## 简体中文

### 本地 RAG：更相关、更私密的知识检索

- 面试回答不再把整个知识库发送给模型；应用会在设备本地检索与当前问题最相关的内容，只把精简后的核心资料和命中片段加入提示词。
- 使用本地多语言向量模型与关键词混合检索，支持中英文问题、追问上下文和项目话题延续。
- 文档分块、向量生成、索引和搜索全部在本机完成；缺少模型或运行时不可用时会自动降级到本地关键词检索。
- 知识库会在后台增量更新索引，并在知识库页面显示索引状态及提供“重建索引”操作。

### 知识库编辑体验

- macOS 新增完整 Markdown 编辑能力，包括标题、列表、引用、粗体、斜体、删除线、下划线、行内代码和链接。
- Windows 同步加入 Markdown 编辑器与知识库条目编辑改进，保持两端内容结构一致。
- 改进项目编辑、知识条目分类和中英文界面细节。

### 稳定性

- 改进蓝牙麦克风与音频处理中断时的恢复行为。
- 修复 Swift 6 与 ONNX Runtime C API 的指针桥接，macOS 的 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 构建均已验证。
- macOS 与 Windows 共用同一套分块、token 估算和检索规则，并新增跨平台一致性测试。

## English

### Local RAG: more relevant, more private retrieval

- Interview answers no longer send the entire knowledge base to the selected model. The app retrieves relevant passages locally and adds only a compact core profile and matched context to the prompt.
- Hybrid multilingual vector and keyword retrieval supports English and Chinese questions, conversational follow-ups and project-topic continuity.
- Chunking, embeddings, indexing and search all run on the device. If the model or runtime is unavailable, the app falls back safely to local keyword retrieval.
- Knowledge indexes update incrementally in the background, with status and a rebuild action available from the knowledge-base screen.

### Knowledge editing

- macOS gains full Markdown editing for headings, lists, quotes, bold, italic, strikethrough, underline, inline code and links.
- Windows gains matching Markdown and knowledge-entry editing improvements so content remains consistent across platforms.
- Project editing, entry classification and bilingual interface details have been refined.

### Reliability

- Improved recovery from Bluetooth microphone and audio-processing interruptions.
- Fixed Swift 6 bridging to the ONNX Runtime C API; both Intel and Apple Silicon macOS builds are verified.
- macOS and Windows now share equivalent chunking, token estimation and retrieval rules, backed by cross-platform consistency tests.
